tools.name: dagrun_next
tools.description: List nodes that are ready to run: dependencies done, artifacts not yet valid. Returns the generated prompt so a caller can hand it to an agent.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_claim
tools.description: Atomically take a node for an owner. Fails when the node is done, leased, blocked on dependencies, or a concurrency cap is reached.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_done
tools.description: Verify a node's declared artifacts and mark it done. Returns isError when the contract is not met and force is false.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

force.description: mark done even when artifacts do not verify

tools.name: dagrun_fail
tools.description: Mark a node failed with a reason.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_skip
tools.description: Mark a node skipped with a reason.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_status
tools.description: Run status: per-status counts, progress, and every node with attempts, owner, and last error.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_validate
tools.description: Re-check every node against the filesystem. Reports nodes recorded done that no longer verify, and nodes already satisfied that are not marked done.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_plan
tools.description: Validate a plan file, install it as the run, and return the PERT summary (waves, critical path).

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_explain
tools.description: Diagnose one node: which predicate failed, why, and what to do next.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_trace
tools.description: The merged execution trace: every event from every worker, in time order. This is what happened, as opposed to what the state file says.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

limit.description: return only the last N events

tools.name: dagrun_submit
tools.description: Post the run to a Tracera instance at /ingest/agileplus. Fails loud: a non-2xx status is an error, and so is a 2xx whose report carries a non-empty error list. Use dry_run to get the exact payload without sending it.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

dry_run.description: return the payload without sending it

token.description: NAME of the env var holding the bearer token; never the token itself

tools.name: dagrun_run
tools.description: Execute ready nodes by spawning their harnesses, then return the summary. BOUNDED: stops after max_nodes (default 1) so one call cannot hang a client. An agent that wants to drive the whole run should loop next -> claim -> done instead, so it owns each node rather than handing the run to the executor.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

dry_run.description: decide what would run without spawning anything

max_nodes.description: how many nodes to attempt before returning (default 1)

owner.description: owner identity recorded on each claim

template.description: shell command to run for nodes that name no harness

tools.name: dagrun_query
tools.description: Select nodes with a structured query: filter with where, project with select, order and limit. Read-only: it never opens the store, so it cannot create a run.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

limit.description: return at most N rows (0 means no limit)

order_by.description: field to sort by, optionally with a direction: status,desc

select.description: fields to return: id, status, kind, role, owner, title, attempts, artifacts, progress

where.description: predicates such as status=failed, kind=DOC, attempt>=2, artifact=src/x.go

tools.name: dagrun_recover
tools.description: Report nodes stuck in a running state, with owner, lease and attempt count. With force=false (the default) this only reports. With force=true it reclaims the named nodes, or every stuck node when none are named, so they can be claimed again.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

force.description: actually reclaim instead of only reporting

nodes.description: node ids to reclaim; omit to reclaim every node reported stuck

tools.name: dagrun_replan
tools.description: Diff a revised plan against the installed one and report what it would invalidate. READ-ONLY by default: it shows the changes and any blocking nodes, and adopts nothing. Pass apply=true to install the revision; force=true is a separate opt-in that discards work which no longer verifies, so refusing to discard verified work stays the default.

apply.description: install the revision (default false: diff only)

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

file.description: revised plan file to diff against the installed run.yaml

force.description: allow the revision to discard work that no longer verifies

tools.name: dagrun_stats
tools.description: Per-kind duration, adoption and retry statistics for the run, as both a structure and a rendered table.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_lint
tools.description: Run the semantic plan linter over the installed plan: well-formed but wrong problems. Advisory findings are warn: prefixed and do not fail the call.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_doctor
tools.description: Read-only health check of the run directory: missing plan, unwritable paths, harness availability, stale worktrees. Reports a missing plan as a finding rather than failing.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)

tools.name: dagrun_export
tools.description: Emit the run for another system as json, agileplus, or tracera. Returns the rendered document as text so its key order stays stable.

dir.description: run directory holding run.yaml and state.json (default .dagrun)
